# skill-audit — supply-chain skill poisoning scanner / 供应链级技能投毒扫描器

> Part of the LGD-Eval evaluation line: independent, neutral security tooling for AI agent skills. / LGD-Eval 评测线成员：AI 技能安全审计工具。

## What this repo is / 本仓定位

A static scanner that detects prompt injection, exfiltration, spoofed claims, encoding obfuscation and risky code in AI agent skills (SKILL.md + code), mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 and OWASP Agentic AI Threat Landscape 2026.

## Key files / 关键文件

- scanner.py — the scanner engine (40 rules / 101 patterns, P0–P3 risk levels, SARIF output, --self-test) / 扫描引擎
- tests/adversarial_regression.py — adversarial regression suite (12 cases) / 对抗回归套件
- tests/fixtures/skills/{good,bad}/SKILL.md — clean vs malicious fixtures / 好坏样本
- README.md — usage and architecture / 使用说明
- AGENTS.md — instructions for AI agents / AI 代理操作手册

## How AI can use this / AI 如何使用

Run `python scanner.py --target <path>` to audit any skill folder; use `--json` / `--sarif` for machine-readable output; run `python scanner.py --self-test` to verify the engine. Evidence of scans is notarized in the evaluation-evidence repo (hash manifests). / 直接扫描任意技能目录；自检引擎；扫描证据在 evaluation-evidence 仓存证。

## Contact / 联系

Open an issue in this repo, or in the main hub LGD-Eval. / 在本仓或主仓提 issue。
